scientific_integrity: The complete graph-orbit proof and open-ladder recurrence establish the novel fixed-space identifications. scientific_limitations: Only order-two elements of the indicated natural dihedral-by-layer-swap group, cycle length at least five; half-turn homotopy types use established nonequivariant classifications. Higher-order subgroup-fixed spaces and full equivariant homotopy types are not classified.
title: Geometric fixed-point homotopy of every natural involution of circular-ladder independence complexes
